comparison_with_upstream_stored_output.assessment: Same size and layout. True-posterior points and the OT panel match visually (50 differing pixels in the OT third). The multinomial panel differs in a few points (4270 differing pixels, 707 with change > 0.3). The diffusion panel differs visibly (50599 px): the same multimodal coverage of the three posterior clusters, but a different realisation. The upstream author's run environment (JAX version, platform) is not recorded in the notebook, and the diffusion_resampling default path has had no algorithmic change since the notebook commit 6aa3e1f (only jitter=0./einsum=False switches were added). The cause is therefore unknown. This is a qualitative difference from the stored output only; the tool references are the locally executed results above.

limitations: The notebook prints no numbers. The only notebook output is the figure; the numeric references come from the capture driver, which runs the same notebook code, and are tied to the papermill run by a byte-identical figure.
Bitwise replay was observed on this CPU / jax 0.7.2 / x64 setup. Other platforms or JAX versions may differ (see the stored-output comparison).
diffusion_resampling uses exp(log_ws) directly; the saved log_ws are already logsumexp-normalised, as in the notebook.
